title: apm-go copilot plugin.json (.github/plugin/plugin.json)
description: Self-authored schema for apm-go's PluginManifest.ToJSONValue output (internal/pack/bundle/pluginjson.go) for the copilot ecosystem, which never includes mcpServers (not part of the Copilot plugin manifest schema; internal/pack/bundle/pluginjson.go's MCPServers doc comment). additionalProperties:false means a document containing mcpServers fails validation against this file -- use apm-plugin-claude.schema.json for that ecosystem instead.
